sources.providers.tmdb.description: Metadata, artwork, ratings, and catalogs from The Movie Database.
sources.providers.tvdb.description: Series-focused metadata, artwork, and episode structure from TheTVDB.
sources.providers.fanart.description: High-quality posters, backgrounds, and logos from Fanart.tv.
sources.providers.rpdb.description: Add ratings and scores onto movie and series posters.
sources.providers.topposters.description: High-quality posters with rating and trend badges. Takes priority over other rated-poster hosts when selected.
sources.providers.aioratings.description: Drop-in RPDB-compatible rated posters with customizable badges and award overlays.
sources.providers.openposterdb.descripti: Open, self-hostable RPDB-compatible rated posters (hosted at openposterdb.com).
sources.providers.trakt.description: Track what you watch and sync progress with Trakt.tv.
sources.providers.simkl.description: Track movies, series, and anime with SIMKL lists and history.
sources.providers.mdblist.description: Import MDBList catalogs and ratings into your library.
sources.providers.publicmetadb.descripti: Personal lists, Up Next, picks, and watch tracking synced with PublicMetaDB.
sources.providers.imdb.description: Full metadata via Cinemeta — titles, artwork, credits, ratings, and IMDb identifiers.
sources.providers.anilist.description: Anime metadata, catalogs, and tracking powered by AniList.
sources.providers.mal.description: Anime lists and tracking through MyAnimeList.
sources.providers.kitsu.description: Anime metadata and catalogs from Kitsu.
sources.providers.gemini.description: AI-assisted search and discovery with Google Gemini.
sources.providers.groq.description: Fast AI title search and discovery powered by Groq (Llama models).
sources.providers.openrouter.description: AI search through OpenRouter — access many models with one API key.
